title: Demonstrate the use of Japanese demonstratives
prompt: Explain the difference between 'kore', 'sore', and 'are' in Japanese and give an example sentence for each.
hint: Use 'kore' for things near the speaker, 'sore' for things near the listener, and 'are' for things far from both.
sample: Kore wa pen desu. (This is a pen.) Sore wa hon desu. (That is a book.) Are wa ki desu. (That over there is a tree.)

ja.prompt: 日本語の指示語「これ」「それ」「あれ」の違いを説明し、それぞれの例文を挙げてください。
ja.hint: 話し手の近くにあるものは「これ」、聞き手の近くにあるものは「それ」、両方から離れているものは「あれ」を使います。
ja.sample: これはペンです。 それは本です。 あれは木です。

local.sample: Kore wa pen desu. (This is a pen.) Sore wa hon desu. (That is a book.) Are wa ki desu. (That over there is a tree.)

zh.prompt: 說明日語中「これ」、「それ」、「あれ」的差別，並各舉一個例句。
zh.hint: 「これ」用於說話者附近的東西，「それ」用於聽話者附近的東西，「あれ」用於雙方都遠離的東西。
zh.sample: これはペンです。（這是筆。）それは本です。（那是書。）あれは木です。（那邊的是樹。）

en.sample: Kore wa pen desu. (This is a pen.) Sore wa hon desu. (That is a book.) Are wa ki desu. (That over there is a tree.)

title: Use of the topic particle 'wa' in Japanese
prompt: Explain the function of the particle 'wa' in Japanese sentences and provide an example sentence.
hint: The particle 'wa' marks the topic of the sentence, indicating what the sentence is about.
sample: Kore wa pen desu. (As for this, it is a pen.)

ja.hint: 「は」は文の話題を示す助詞で、その文が何について話しているかを表します。

local.prompt: Explain the function of the particle 'wa' in Japanese sentences and provide an example sentence.

title: Describe colors and adjectives in Japanese
prompt: Describe how to say colors and simple adjectives in Japanese and use them in a sentence.
hint: Use color words like 'akai' (red), 'shiroi' (white), and adjectives like 'omoshiroi' (interesting), 'tsumaranai' (boring).
sample: Kono eiga wa omoshiroi desu. (This movie is interesting.) Kono hon wa shiroi desu. (This book is white.)

ja.prompt: 日本語で色や簡単な形容詞の言い方を説明し、例文を作ってください。
ja.hint: 「赤い」「白い」などの色の言葉や、「面白い」「つまらない」などの形容詞を使います。
ja.sample: この映画は面白いです。 この本は白いです。

local.sample: Kono eiga wa omoshiroi desu. (This movie is interesting.) Kono hon wa shiroi desu. (This book is white.)

zh.prompt: 說明如何用日語說顏色和簡單的形容詞，並造句。

title: Express possession using 'no' in Japanese
prompt: Explain how to express possession in Japanese using the particle 'no' and give example sentences.
hint: Use 'no' between two nouns to show possession, like 'Tanaka-san no kuruma' (Tanaka's car).
sample: Kore wa Tanaka-san no pen desu. (This is Tanaka's pen.)

ja.hint: 二つの名詞の間に「の」を入れて所有を表します。例：田中さんの車。
ja.sample: これは田中さんのペンです。

title: Practice using 'kawaii' and 'sugoi' in Japanese
prompt: Use the adjectives 'kawaii' (cute) and 'sugoi' (amazing) in sentences to describe objects or people.
hint: Place the adjective before the noun or at the end of the sentence with 'desu'.
sample: Kono neko wa kawaii desu. (This cat is cute.) Ano eiga wa sugoi desu. (That movie is amazing.)
